_comment: Model-tier matrix for delegation-loop review calls. Row = task category, each tier is an ordered list of {model, effort} fallbacks. Owner rule (2026-10-31): only Haiku is used by default. Luna stays out of default picks (owner rule 2026-10-20); pass --model to use it for one run. See issue #179 and #182 for the schema.

coding.source: 2026-10-31: Haiku-only defaults; Luna excluded by owner rule 2026-10-20
coding.note: Haiku is the only default model. Tier2 is Haiku at xhigh.
